name: 360 Creator
description: A single profile to control most editing software used in the creative industries: Photoshop, Premiere, Pro Tools, OBS, digiKam, etc. It works with the Art Craft suit, too. Press one LED button to recall a workstation, keep pressing the same LED button for the next workstation pages. LED Buttons are color coded according to the software they control. Simple, yet effective.
author: Rand0mB0y
